summary: Recommends which Differentiated Services Code Point (DSCP) values web browsers should put on the different kinds of WebRTC traffic, such as audio, video and data. Networks may use these markings to give packets different forwarding treatment hop by hop. It is a standards-track document.

eli5.summary: Mail can be marked "urgent" or "regular". This document says which marks a browser should stick on its video, sound and data packets so the network can treat the more time-sensitive ones with more care.
